suite: Actual implementation numerical and game tests

tests.name: Circular quarter-orbit agrees with analytic position and velocity
One and one hundred full circular orbits close
Elliptical apsides and Kepler period match vis-viva
Energy and angular momentum are conserved across 30,000 seconds
Backward propagation reverses an elliptic coast
Step partition does not change the flight
Hyperbolic escape preserves positive energy
Near-parabolic propagation is continuous on both sides of escape speed
Stumpff functions have correct limits and remain continuous near zero
Radial and transverse impulse axes are orthogonal and use m/s
Clockwise orbit burns preserve the prograde convention
Radial zero-angular-momentum orbits have finite apsides
Hohmann transfer matches endpoint radii and final circular speed
Closest-approach search recovers the phased rendezvous
Atmospheric recall catches ordinary surface approach
Apsidal event check catches a grazing boundary between time samples
Budget, NaN, negative delay, and excessive impulse are rejected without mutation
Expired delivery window closes the flight without spending fuel
Sandbox time and delta-v remain unlimited
